title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_priestdaddy_by_patricia_lockwood_cdh21 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_priestdaddy_by_patricia_lockwood_cdh21' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
